acceptance: The shell has a documented source-owned token contract and no raw recurring brand colors/spacings are required for ordinary shell states.
Interactive native controls expose labels, keyboard focus visibility, disabled/invalid-capable styling conventions, and at least 44px primary touch targets.
The shell reflows without a fixed minimum desktop width at representative wide, tablet, and narrow viewport CSS breakpoints.
Reduced-motion preference disables non-essential transitions and no motion is required to understand state.
The first brand language is visibly distinct but remains legible in dark and light color schemes.
Focused UI contract tests, production standalone build/smoke, and exact-head Ubuntu/Windows repository CI pass.

required: Production standalone build and HTTP smoke after UI-system changes.
Exact-head Ubuntu and Windows repository CI.

minimality.rationale: Use CSS custom properties and native semantic controls before qualifying any external primitive/component dependency.

requirements: Do not represent automated/static checks as complete accessibility certification.
Do not hide the session-only non-persistence boundary at any responsive size.

outcome: The Ineractive control-plane shell uses a coherent first-party token system, typography hierarchy, accessible native-first primitives, responsive layout, and first recognizable brand language without introducing an unnecessary component dependency stack.
rationale: Canonical P01-S04-T01 frontier after SG-000012 workspace shell completion.

risk.recovery: Revert SG-000013 token/primitives/responsive/brand changes and evidence; no data or external side effect is introduced.

scope_in: Define source-owned semantic design tokens for color, typography, spacing, radius, border, focus, elevation, and layout.
Apply a deliberate first Ineractive brand language to the existing control-plane shell without copying a third-party identity.
Add native-first accessible Button, TextField, Badge, and visually-hidden/focus treatment conventions only where they reduce repeated shell markup.
Make the workspace shell responsive across desktop, tablet, and narrow mobile widths without hiding core session-only truth or activity.
Add visible focus states, minimum touch-target policy, reduced-motion behavior, semantic labels/status, and high-contrast-safe token relationships.
Add deterministic token/UI contract tests and re-run production standalone build/smoke.
scope_out: No Base UI, React Aria, Radix, shadcn registry, Tailwind, Storybook, animation library, or external component dependency until its dedicated qualification/admission task.
No visual editor, generated-product design compiler, registry, or P08 Design OS implementation.
No claim of complete WCAG conformance from static checks alone.
title: IN-P01-S04-T01 Build first accessible tokenized UI system
